summary: Reviewed the 9 changed files from the documentos->documents rename batch (ContratoFormModal.tsx, ContratoViewModal.tsx, ShareViewModal.tsx, SharePendenteFormModal.tsx, RH.tsx, ArtistaVisao360Modal.tsx, ArtistaSignupPublic.tsx, Configuracoes.tsx, LeadFormModal.tsx) for the same PT/EN corruption pattern already fixed at Configuracoes.tsx:828. Found and filed 3 additional instances (find-5e8cfec1 ContratoViewModal.tsx:476, find-74aef606 ArtistaVisao360Modal.tsx:1835-1836, find-d8e4e852 LeadFormModal.tsx:1035). All other 'documents'/'contracts'/'artists'/'shares'/'leads'/'employees' occurrences in these files are internal identifiers (variable names, tab value keys, data-testid, storage folder paths, form field ids) which are correctly not user-facing, or are already-correct PT labels (e.g. Documentos Vinculados, Documentos Anexos). 'Share' used as a domain term in SharePendenteFormModal.tsx (Tipo de Share, % Share) predates this rename batch and is out of scope. No other interaction/label defects found in these files.
